description: A complete six-page Divi 5 website for a plant shop, florist, garden centre or nursery, ready to make your own. Home, The Plants, Workshops, Care Guides, Our Story and Visit share one warm, leafy identity: soft sage backgrounds, a deep rose accent, Newsreader headings and rounded cards. Every section is built from proven, validated recipes and a single design language and style kit, so buttons, accordions, forms and type match on every page, on desktop, tablet and phone. An overlapping photo hero, a scrolling row of what you sell, a fresh-this-week gallery, a quote slider, best-seller cards with light and water notes, a light-matching comparison, workshop tickets and a zigzag of what guests make, a seasonal care calendar, a plant-troubleshooting FAQ, a founder note and a visit page with a form are all in place. Names, prices and reviews are sample copy: swap in your own and publish. No lorem ipsum, no broken layouts. One simple commercial license, unlimited client sites.
